Upgrading to a new phone often comes with a hidden cost: if the new and old iPhones have different dimensions, you'll need to buy a new case too.

For anyone upgrading from last year's Pro model to the iPhone 18 Pro, it initially seemed like a new case would be necessary. However, two accessory manufacturers disagree — and one is betting big on this claim...

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman posted a photo on Twitter of an Otterbox case already on sale at Best Buy, noting that it's compatible with both the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro. The bottom right corner of the packaging reads in both English and French:

for iPhone 18 Pro iPhone 17 Pro

Gurman himself wasn't willing to commit fully, adding a comment that it was "too early to tell." But Matt Ronge of Astropad — which makes anti-reflective screen protectors for iPhones — said his suppliers have told him the same thing.

Conflicting reports on iPhone Pro thickness

Last year, a leaker pointed out that at least the iPhone 18 Pro Max would be thicker and heavier than its predecessor. That report didn't mention the smaller Pro model, but materials leaked from an iPhone supplier show that the iPhone 18 Pro will be two millimeters thicker than the previous generation.

This trend is consistent with previous developments, as both iPhone 17 Pro models were thicker and heavier than their predecessors.

However, not all leakers agree with this claim. One says the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be exactly the same thickness as last year's model.

9to5Mac's take

Apple does sometimes provide dimensional information early to reputable case manufacturers so that third-party cases can launch alongside new iPhones. But on the other hand, accessory manufacturers sometimes just gamble based on rumors, and sometimes they guess wrong. Personally, I wouldn't pre-order any case before the new iPhone is officially announced.
